title: Mass bounds pass to ConvergesWeakly-limits of currents on varying domains
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, all sets U_j ⊆ ℝ^P (j ∈ ℕ) and V ⊆ ℝ^P, all currents T_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U_j) and S ∈ 𝒟_n(V), every set W ⊆ ℝ^P and every B ∈ [0, ∞]: if T_j ⇀ S in the sense of ConvergesWeakly (currentEval(T_j, ω) → S(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(V)) and, for all sufficiently large j, W ⊆ U_j and M_W(T_j) ≤ B, then M_W(S) ≤ B. Here M_W = massOn is the supremum of ofReal(T(ω)) over test forms ω of the current's domain with tsupport ω ⊆ W and Euclidean coefficient norm ≤ 1 everywhere.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Us : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : (j : ℕ) → GeometricCurrentOn (Us j) n) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (B : ℝ≥0∞), ConvergesWeakly Ts S → (∀ᶠ j in atTop, W ⊆ Us j ∧ (Ts j).massOn W ≤ B) → S.massOn W ≤ B
